# v0.13

Released 2026-11-06.

## Highlights

- The bash/yad launcher is replaced by a Rust GTK4 launcher.
- pkgproxy becomes a workshop SDK, so apt and snap downloads are cached between builds.
- READMEs refreshed.

- b411be3b156e90be46f63e7d0b86886218ee9ef1: Update various READMEs
- 33dc421b4fb6bfe126071dc7ba86fe33eca6dbee: Replace bash/yad launcher with a Rust GTK4 launcher
- ee61e9b3e2d91fd83e35c3344e42f2307bca516b: Set up pkgproxy as a workshop SDK
